owner.label: Runs on:
owner.self: Curation runs here. The other machines sharing this vault leave the derived documents to this one.
owner.other: Curation runs on {{machine}}. This machine reads what that one derives and never rewrites it.
owner.unowned: No machine has been named, so curation runs wherever this vault is opened. That is right for a vault on one machine; on two, both curate the same items into their own documents and the vault ends up holding the same knowledge twice.
